title: What to do as a family in October | Family Season
description: Three ready plans for October for the whole family: an evening film marathon, a spooky month with Halloween, and getting to know your own city. Open one, change it, print it on A4.
label: October
heading: What to do as a family in October
lead: October gets dark early and wet outside: the evening belongs to the house again, and it has to be planned — otherwise it goes into phones in separate rooms.
There is still walking weather, though, and the end of the month brings Halloween and the autumn half-term. October comes out double: half at home, half around the city.
seasonsText: Each one opens in full: the weeks, a project for everybody in the family, the goal of the month. Any of them can be rewritten for you and printed on two A4 sheets.
actionText: If none of them fits, build your own: the theme of the month, four weeks and a project each. It prints the same way — two pages, and onto the fridge.
moreText: Other families put their seasons up too — there are more on the showcase.
